description: A fixed, source-grounded ontology of the supplied Project SEKAI metadata. Relationships describe source associations, not eligibility, ownership, or historical availability guarantees.

events.label: Event
events.definition: An event in the supplied game metadata. Its competition window starts at start_at and ends at aggregate_at; closed_at is a later lifecycle boundary, not the competition end.

fields.event_type: Source event category, for example marathon. Do not translate marathon into real-world distance.
fields.start_at: Competition start as Unix epoch milliseconds (UTC).
fields.aggregate_at: Competition aggregation boundary as Unix epoch milliseconds (UTC).
fields.closed_at: Source lifecycle closure timestamp in epoch milliseconds; not the competition end.
fields.unit: Source unit enum. The value none means no unit is specified; do not infer a unit from an event title.

cards.label: Card
cards.definition: A collectible card definition, not an individual user's owned card. Linked to its character by character_id.

fields.prefix: Original Japanese card title/prefix, preserved verbatim.
fields.attr: Card attribute enum: cool, cute, happy, mysterious, or pure. This is a game attribute, not a personality inference.
fields.card_rarity_type: Source rarity category. rarity_1 through rarity_4 denote star categories; rarity_birthday is a separate category, not five stars.
fields.release_at: Source release timestamp in Unix epoch milliseconds (UTC).
fields.support_unit: Support-unit source enum; none denotes unspecified support affiliation.

characters.label: Character
characters.definition: A game character. The original file is named chracters.json. Display Japanese names as first_name followed by given_name, and English names from the supplied English fields.

fields.first_name_english: Source-supplied English family-name component; this is not generated translation.
fields.unit: Source unit affiliation enum. Preserve the enum; friendly labels are aliases only.
fields.height: Character height in centimeters, interpreted from the source field; no biological inference is implied.

event_cards.label: Event–card association
event_cards.definition: An explicit source association between an event and a card. Membership alone does not establish that the card is a pickup, is obtainable in that event, or grants a positive bonus.

fields.bonus_rate: Source bonus-rate value, retained without inventing percentage or stacking semantics.
fields.leader_bonus_rate: Source leader-bonus-rate value, retained without inventing stacking semantics.

gachas.label: Gacha
gachas.definition: A source gacha/banner definition. Its details identify the listed card pool, while pickups identify explicitly marked pickup cards. Time overlap with an event does not establish an event-specific gacha link.

fields.start_at: Gacha start timestamp in Unix epoch milliseconds (UTC).
fields.end_at: Gacha end timestamp in Unix epoch milliseconds (UTC).
fields.name: Original Japanese source banner name.

gacha_details: A card listed in a gacha pool. weight is a source weight, not a complete probability; do not compute drop rates from weight alone.
gacha_pickups: A card explicitly marked as a gacha pickup in the source.
gacha_behaviors: A source draw behavior, including draw counts, costs and execution limits.
gacha_rarity_rates: A source rarity/lottery rate row scoped to its parent gacha. A rate for a rarity is not an individual card's drop rate.
card_parameters: A source card statistic at a specific card_level and card_parameter_type; power is that component's value, not automatically total team power.
card_training_costs: A source special-training cost entry. Nested costs remain available in raw_record.
card_master_resources: A source master-rank resource requirement entry. Resource structures remain available in raw_record.
event_reward_ranges: A source event ranking reward interval, with inclusive from_rank and to_rank boundaries.
event_rewards: A source reward entry associated with an event reward range. Resource box identifiers are opaque when their definition is absent.

relationships: A card depicts the referenced character.

Card listed in the gacha pool; not necessarily a pickup.

Rarity rate scoped to the containing gacha, regardless of reused group IDs.

rules: Dataset coverage is the supplied snapshot, not the live game. Never claim current availability.
Use DISTINCT when counting cards across many-to-many event or gacha associations.
Preserve source enum values, zero bonuses, nulls, and none values. None is not evidence of membership in a particular unit.
Convert epoch milliseconds using to_timestamp(value / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'.
Source IDs for skills, resource boxes and other absent entity files remain opaque references; do not fabricate their descriptions.
Generated translations are convenience labels, never canonical English game localization.
Translate questions into queries only when the available data can support them; otherwise explain the missing information.
